reading.title: 인공지능과 교육의 미래
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is transforming education by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Teachers can use AI tools to identify struggling students early and provide targeted interventions. However, concerns about privacy, data security, and the potential loss of human interaction in classrooms remain significant challenges. Despite these concerns, many educators believe AI will enhance rather than replace traditional teaching methods.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one advantage of AI in education?
options: A) It eliminates the need for teachers
B) It personalizes learning experiences for students
C) It reduces educational costs significantly
D) It prevents all learning problems
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly'라고 명시되어 있어, AI가 학생들의 학습을 개인화할 수 있다고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What does the passage identify as a concern about AI in education?
options: A) It is too expensive to implement
B) It only benefits advanced students
C) Privacy and data security issues
D) It cannot identify struggling students
questions.explanation: 'concerns about privacy, data security, and the potential loss of human interaction'이라는 구절에서 프라이버시와 데이터 보안이 우려사항임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What is the author's overall perspective on AI in education?
options: A) AI should completely replace teachers
B) AI will harm the education system
C) AI will enhance rather than replace traditional teaching
D) AI has no impact on education
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장 'many educators believe AI will enhance rather than replace traditional teaching methods'에서 저자의 긍정적인 관점을 볼 수 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work has a negative impact on employee productivity and company culture'?

structure.intro: 자신의 입장을 명확히 밝히기 (agree 또는 disagree). 예: 'While remote work presents certain challenges, I disagree with the notion that it negatively impacts productivity and company culture.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: 생산성 측면 - 재택근무는 집중력 향상, 통근시간 절감 등의 이점 제시
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: 회사 문화 측면 - 화상 회의, 온라인 협업 도구로 유지 가능하며, 유연성이 직원 만족도 증진
structure.conclusion: 결론에서 전체 입장 재확인하고, 원격근무는 적절히 관리될 경우 긍정적 결과 도출 가능함을 강조

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study in libraries with a quiet environment. Others prefer to study in cafes with background noise. Which environment do you prefer for studying, and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in...
sample_points: 첫 번째 아이디어: 조용한 도서관 환경에서 집중력 향상, 방해 요소 제거로 효율적 학습 가능
두 번째 아이디어: 카페의 배경음은 완전 침묵보다 뇌 활동 자극, 다양한 환경 적응력 개발에 도움

listening.title: 대학 상담실 상담 장면
listening.script: Student: Hi, Professor. I'm struggling with my time management this semester. I have too many classes and I'm working part-time as well. Advisor: I understand. Many students face similar challenges. Let's look at your schedule. How many hours are you working each week? Student: About 20 hours. Advisor: That's significant. And how many credits are you taking? Student: 15 credits, which is a full load. Advisor: I see the problem. You're actually taking on too much. I recommend reducing your work hours to 10 hours per week or dropping one class this semester. Student: But I need the money for tuition. Advisor: I understand your concern. However, overloading yourself might affect your grades, which could impact your future opportunities. Have you considered applying for financial aid or scholarships? Student: Actually, I haven't looked into that seriously. Advisor: That could be a game-changer. Let's set up an appointment with our financial aid office. They can help you find resources to reduce your work hours without sacrificing your education.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: A) To discuss the student's financial situation
B) To address the student's time management problems
C) To help the student find a part-time job
D) To encourage the student to drop out
questions.explanation: 학생이 처음부터 시간 관리 문제로 상담을 요청했고, 학생 상담사가 스케줄을 검토하면서 일과 학업의 균형 문제를 다루고 있습니다.

questions.q: How many hours per week is the student currently working?
options: A) 10 hours
B) 15 hours
C) 20 hours
D) 25 hours

questions.q: What does the advisor suggest as a solution?
options: A) Work more hours to earn more money
B) Drop out of university
C) Reduce work hours or drop a class, and explore financial aid
D) Continue with the current schedule
questions.explanation: 상담사는 근무 시간을 10시간으로 줄이거나 한 과목을 드롭할 것을 권유하고, 재정 지원과 장학금을 찾아볼 것을 제안합니다.
